en.tagline: a gym log that tells you what to lift next
en.pitch: Pick your exercises and tick your sets. When you hit every rep, Goat adds weight next time. Home shows which muscles you trained and how they are doing: yellow is maintaining, green is improving, blue is optimal.
en.free: Goat is free, and always will be. No account, no tracking. Your workouts stay on your phone.

iphone.title: Goat is ready to try on your iPhone
iphone.text: Get TestFlight, Apple’s app for trying apps before they come out. Then open this page on your iPhone and tap Join the beta.

es.tagline: el registro del gimnasio que te dice qué levantar
es.pitch: Elige tus ejercicios y marca tus series. Cuando completas todas las repeticiones, Goat sube el peso la próxima vez. El inicio muestra qué músculos has entrenado y cómo van: amarillo es mantener, verde es mejorar y azul es óptimo.
es.free: Goat es gratis, y siempre lo será. Sin cuenta y sin rastreo. Tus entrenos se quedan en tu móvil.
